{{Quote|I want you troopers to remember&mdash;we're shoulder-to-shoulder on those front lines. Brothers! And sometimes we may quarrel, but no matter what, we are ''united''. Rule one: we fight together.|Colt|<ref name="CC" />}}
'''Colt''' was an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Rancor Battalion/Legends|Rancor Battalion]] and an advocate of unity on the battlefield, Colt was assigned to [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to select potential ARC [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] candidates from [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] nearing the end of their training.

Colt was still on Kamino when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched an [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|attack]] on the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities there. The ARC [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] participated in the defense of Tipoca [[City/Legends|City]] but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Confederate [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm impressed. You trained 'em well.|Colt, remarking on Bravo Squad's performance to the trainers|<ref name="CC" />}}
One of many [[Clone trooper/Legends|soldiers]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and trained to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="DB" /> Colt was an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] tasked with leading [[Rancor Battalion/Legends|Rancor Battalion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CC" />

[[Gender/Legends|He]] was also given the task of overseeing the selection and training of new ARC [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] recruits.<ref name="CWA Shop: Colt">{{TCWA|set=Commander Colt}}</ref> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Colt was reassigned to Kamino to oversee the final stages of training for [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], and the members of the cadet [[Squad/Legends|squad]] who performed the best in the last challenge were to be selected as ARC troop candidates. Introduced to the cadet squads by the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] instructor [[Bric/Legends|Bric]], Colt addressed the men, stressing the importance of unity on the battlefield.<ref name="CC" />

[[File:Arcbricscrubber.png|thumb|left|250px|Commander Colt and the instructors observe the progress of clone cadets.]]
He selected [[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)/Legends|Bravo Squad]] to first perform the final challenge, as the squad's cadets had completed their trial run in record [[Time/Legends|time]]&mdash;"ARC trooper time," as Colt saw it. From an observation platform overlooking the practice chamber, the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] instructed the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] trainer [[El-Les/Legends|El-Les]] to initiate version THX, variable [[1138 (easter egg)|1138]], of the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]]. Bravo Squad's performance in the test greatly impressed Colt, who congratulated the instructors on their training of the cadets.

[[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]] was the next to run the simulation, but Colt felt their handling of the test was "sloppy" and "unorthodox," and he soon ended the challenge when the cadets left [[Droidbait/Legends|one of their own]] behind. The ARC trooper additionally berated the squad for disobeying directives and breaking formation. Left with no choice, El-Les failed Domino Squad, though the cadets later succeeded when given a second opportunity to pass the simulation.<ref name="CC" />

Colt remained on Kamino as the war progressed and was in Tipoca [[City/Legends|City]] when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched an [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|attack]] on the planet. The commander assisted with the defense of the city,<ref name="ARC" /> leading ARC troopers during the battle<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2010 Basic Figure|pack=#52: Clone Commander Colt|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW52-Colt.asp}}</ref> and engaging Separatist [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s within one of the city's halls. Outnumbered, Colt was preoccupied with fending off the remaining [[Droid/Legends|droids]] when the Confederate [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] sneaked up behind him.

Ventress grabbed Colt in a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force grip]], telekinetically lifting the helpless ARC commander off the floor and choking him with the force. The clone futilely struggled in her grip as she slammed him against the wall. The force of the impact knocked the clone’s [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|helmet]] off. Still strangling Colt within her [[The Force/Legends|Force]] grip, Ventress slowly ignited her lightsaber, smiling at the struggling trooper. Then, she telekinetically pulled the commander into the blade of her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], [[Shiak|impaling]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.<ref name="ARC" /> She then kissed the trooper as she disengaged her lightsaber, letting his lifeless body crumple to the floor.<ref name="ARCT Blu-ray">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Show an ARC trooper how it's done.|Colt, addressing the clone cadets|<ref name="CC" />}}
[[File:ColtFull-SWI125.png|thumb|right|200px|Colt, in his experimental Phase II armor]]
An expert in ground and [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] warfare,<ref name="Hasbro" /> Colt believed strongly in the unity of and brotherhood between his fellow clone troopers&mdash;especially when in battle&mdash;and stressed this lesson to the clone cadets whose training he was assigned to supervise.

Bravo Squad's performance, specifically, greatly impressed the commander&mdash;the cadets had completed their trial run in record "ARC trooper" time and had performed their final test flawlessly. His evaluation of Domino Squad, conversely, was quite different&mdash;the cadets' shoddy handling of the Citadel Challenge had revealed their disunity and noncompliance, and Colt wasted no time in berating them for their mistakes.<ref name="CC" />

When faced with a Separatist attack on Tipoca City, Colt and other clones fought against invading [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] despite overwhelming odds. The commander continued to fight even after his comrades were killed, until he himself was struck down in battle.<ref name="ARC" /> The pattern on his helmet identified Colt as a member of the Rancor Battalion.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Equipment==
As an ARC trooper, Colt made use of white experimental Phase II armor, with red and gray markings, which included a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] with a [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]]; a [[Kama/Legends|kama]]; a double [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]]; additional gray [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating on the chest, arms, and legs; a survival pack; and two [[Holster/Legends|holsters]] for [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]].<ref name="CC" /> Additionally, Colt was armed with a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S blaster carbine]].<ref name="ARC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Colt first appeared in "[[Clone Cadets]]," the first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', having previously been shown in promotional material for the season. He later appeared in the second episode, "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]." Although he was not identified by name in either "ARC Troopers" or the accompanying episode guide, the ARC trooper killed by Ventress in the episode wears [[Armor/Legends|armor]] identical to that of Colt, and this article therefore assumes that both characters are one and the same.

A portion of Colt's death in "ARC Troopers" was removed from the aired episode. In the original scene, Ventress gave Colt a [[:File:VentressKissColt-ARCT.png|kiss on the cheek]] after impaling him but before deactivating her lightsaber. This modification was done at the insistence of [[Cartoon Network]] at [[Celebration V]].<ref name="Censor">{{WebCite|url=http://www.bigshinyrobot.com/reviews/archives/16255|text=Big Shiny Robot - Did Clone Wars Get Censored?|author=Young, Bryan ("Swank-mo-tron")|date=2010-09-11|work=Bigshinyrobot.com|archivedate=20111217230233}}</ref> However, the full scene was still present in the Dataclip summary of the episode on Cartoon Network's website,<ref name="Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab02b058b7b012b21ac33e70271|text=Dataclip: ARC Troopers|na=video file}}</ref> as well as on the third season's [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|home video release]].
